title: End-to-end serving latency
caption: The serving tax is the exposed non-model work that consumes the same request budget as inference; concurrent work must not be counted twice.

symbols.name: end-to-end request latency
symbols.meaning: latency visible across the declared request boundary

symbols.name: inference latency
symbols.meaning: model execution time inside that boundary

symbols.name: network latency
symbols.meaning: exposed transfer setup and payload time across machine dependencies

symbols.name: serialization latency
symbols.meaning: host cost of converting payloads to and from wire representations

symbols.name: coordination latency
symbols.meaning: routing, fan-out joining and dependent-service coordination on the critical path

symbols.name: queueing latency
symbols.meaning: waiting for busy serving resources

title: Model lifetime cost
caption: Training is paid once per model version; serving cost recurs with deployment duration and admitted traffic.

symbols.name: lifetime cost
symbols.meaning: total cost of one deployed model version over its lifetime

symbols.name: training cost
symbols.meaning: one-time cost of producing the model version

symbols.name: serving cost per query
symbols.meaning: fully bounded cost of one served query, including billed idle or reserved capacity

symbols.name: deployment duration
symbols.meaning: time the model version remains in service

symbols.name: served query rate
symbols.meaning: rate of admitted, served queries counted in the same boundary as unit cost

title: Batched service rate
caption: Batch service time is fixed overhead plus batch size times marginal per-request cost; throughput rises toward one over the marginal cost as overhead is amortized.

symbols.name: batch size
symbols.meaning: number of requests served together

symbols.name: fixed batch cost
symbols.meaning: batch-invariant setup and synchronization time

symbols.name: marginal request cost
symbols.meaning: incremental service time per additional request

symbols.name: batched service rate
symbols.meaning: requests served per unit time once a batch begins execution

title: Static-batch padding waste
caption: Under the chapter's simplified fixed-membership model, output-length dispersion becomes padded computation that continuous batching can reclaim.

symbols.name: waste fraction
symbols.meaning: share of compute spent on padding rather than useful output positions

symbols.name: mean output length
symbols.meaning: average completed response length in tokens

symbols.name: maximum output length
symbols.meaning: length to which shorter responses are padded or batch width is held

title: KV-cache bytes per token
caption: Each cached token stores keys and values for every layer and KV head; the linear product makes context length an admission budget.

symbols.name: KV bytes per token
symbols.meaning: bytes of accelerator memory required for one token of context

symbols.name: layer count
symbols.meaning: number of transformer layers carrying cached state

symbols.name: KV head count
symbols.meaning: key-value heads per layer; grouped-query attention reduces this count

symbols.name: head dimension
symbols.meaning: dimension of each attention head

symbols.name: bytes per element
symbols.meaning: storage precision of each key or value element

symbols.name: keys and values
symbols.meaning: one key tensor and one value tensor per token per layer

title: Disaggregated KV handoff
caption: Separating prefill and decode converts cache locality into a network transfer with latency and bandwidth terms.

symbols.name: handoff time
symbols.meaning: time to move a request's KV cache from prefill to decode workers

symbols.name: network fixed latency
symbols.meaning: setup, queueing and protocol latency independent of payload size

symbols.name: KV payload
symbols.meaning: bytes of key-value state that must cross the pool boundary

symbols.name: effective bandwidth
symbols.meaning: sustained transfer bandwidth available for the handoff
